messages.subject: An Introduction to R for Causal Modeling -- a new Structured Course
parts:
Hi everyone
I wanted to let you know about a new Structured Course offered by Instats, which provides a comprehensive introduction to R for causal modeling with observational data: An Introduction to R for Causal Modeling: Basic and Advanced Applications.

https://instats.com/structuredcourse/an-introduction-to-r-for-causal-modeling-basic-and-adanced-applications7239

This three-seminar Structured Course provides a comprehensive introduction to R and progresses to multiple applications in causal modeling with observational data. The first two live-streaming seminars introduce R and causal analysis with observational data. The third on-demand seminar covers path analysis in R with applications in causal analysis using instrumental variables as well as mediation and moderation modeling, and is provided free of charge to those who register for the Structured Course. Like all of Instats's Structured Courses, a 10% discount is applied to the livestreamed seminars, and an official Instats certificate of completion is provided at the conclusion of each seminar.

https://instats.com/seminars_courses?view=courses

The Structured Course includes the following three seminars, which can be accessed separately for those who may be interested in taking a look at the content individually:

1) A Gentle Introduction to R

2) Causal Inference with Observational Data in R: Propensity Scores, Inverse Probability Treatment Weighting, and Marginal Structural Models

3) An Introduction to Path Analysis with Instrumental Variables in R

As always, Instats offers discounts for PhD students and participants can engage with the material synchronously or asynchronously for livestreamed seminars. All seminar content is posted to each seminar's webpage and participants have 30 days of access to all course materials, including HD videos, take-home exercises, and all program code/data.

For more information head over to Instats.com where you can stay up to date on all of our upcoming livestreamed and currently available on-demand seminars, as well as our free weekly Office Hours where you can get help with your data analytic challenges.

Best wishes and happy modeling!

Mike
